verses.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.pt: Ora, a fé é a certeza das coisas que se esperam, e a prova das coisas que não se veem.
verses.en_web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
verses.en_bbe: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, and the sign that the things not seen are true.

verses.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.pt: Pois por ela os antigos obtiveram testemunho.
verses.en_web: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.
verses.en_bbe: For by it our fathers had God's approval.

verses.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.pt: Pela fé entendemos que o universo foi aprontado pela palavra de Deus, de maneira que as coisas que se veem não foram feitas de algo visível.
verses.en_web: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
verses.en_bbe: By faith it is clear to us that the order of events was fixed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made from things which only seem to be.

verses.en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Abel ofereceu a Deus melhor sacrifício do que Caim; por isso obteve testemunho de que era justo, pois Deus testemunhou de suas ofertas; e mesmo estando morto, ainda fala por meio dela.
verses.en_web: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Abel made a better offering to God than Cain, and he had witness through it of his righteousness, God giving his approval of his offering: and his voice still comes to us through it though he is dead.

verses.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Enoque foi transportado para não experimentar a morte; e não foi achado, porque Deus havia o transportado; pois antes da sua transportação ele obteve testemunho de ter agradado a Deus.
verses.en_web: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Enoch was taken up to heaven so that he did not see death; he was seen no longer, for God took him away: for before he was taken, witness had been given that he was well-pleasing to God:

verses.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.pt: Ora, sem fé é impossível agradar a Deus. Pois é necessário que aquele que se aproxima de Deus creia que ele existe, e que ele é recompensador dos que o buscam.
verses.en_web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
verses.en_bbe: And without faith it is not possible to be well-pleasing to him, for it is necessary for anyone who comes to God to have the belief that God is, and that he is a rewarder of all those who make a serious search for him.

verses.en: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Noé, divinamente advertido das coisas que ainda se não viam, temeu; e, para salvamento de sua família construiu a arca. Por meio da fé ele condenou o mundo, e foi feito herdeiro da justiça segundo a fé.
verses.en_web: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Noah, being moved by the fear of God, made ready an ark for the salvation of his family, because God had given him news of things which were not seen at the time; and through it the world was judged by him, and he got for his heritage the righteousness which is by faith.

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi chamado para ir ao lugar que havia de receber por herança, obedeceu, e saiu sem que soubesse aonde ia.
verses.en_web: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Abraham did as God said when he was ordered to go out into a place which was to be given to him as a heritage, and went out without knowledge of where he was going.

verses.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.pt: Pela fé, ele habitou na terra de promessa, como em terra que não fosse sua, morando em tendas com Isaque e com Jacó, herdeiros com ele da mesma promessa.
verses.en_web: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
verses.en_bbe: By faith he was a wanderer in the land of the agreement, as in a strange land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who had a part with him in the same heritage:

verses.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.pt: Pois ele esperava a cidade que tem fundamentos firmes, da qual o arquiteto e construtor é Deus.
verses.en_web: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
verses.en_bbe: For he was looking for the strong town, whose builder and maker is God.

verses.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.pt: Pela fé, também, a própria Sara recebeu a capacidade de conceber descendência, e já na idade avançada ela deu à luz, pois considerou fiel aquele que havia prometido.
verses.en_web: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
verses.en_bbe: And by faith Sarah herself had power to give birth, when she was very old, because she had faith in him who gave his word;

verses.en: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.pt: Assim, de um que estava à beira da morte, nasceu uma descendência numerosa como as estrelas do céu, e incontável como a areia na praia do mar.
verses.en_web: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
verses.en_bbe: So that from one man, who was near to death, came children in number as the stars in heaven, or as the sand by the seaside, which may not be numbered.

verses.en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.pt: Permanecendo na fé, todos esses morreram sem receberem as promessas. Mas as viram de longe, creram, e felicitaram-se nelas, declarando que eram estrangeiros e peregrinos na terra.
verses.en_web: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: All these came to their end in faith, not having had the heritage; but having seen it with delight far away, they gave witness that they were wanderers and not of the earth.

verses.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.pt: Pois os que dizem tais coisas mostram claramente que estão buscando a sua própria pátria.
verses.en_web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
verses.en_bbe: For those who say such things make it clear that they are searching for a country for themselves.

verses.en: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.pt: Ora, se estivessem pensando naquela de onde saíram, eles tinham oportunidade de voltar.
verses.en_web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
verses.en_bbe: And truly if they had kept in mind the country from which they went out, they would have had chances of turning back.

verses.en: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.pt: Mas agora desejam uma melhor, isto é, a celestial. Por isso Deus não se envergonha deles, de ser chamado o Deus deles, porque já lhes preparou uma cidade.
verses.en_web: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.en_bbe: But now their desire is for a better country, that is to say, for one in heaven; and so it is no shame to God to be named their God; for he has made ready a town for them.

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.pt: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi provado, ofereceu Isaque; aquele que havia recebido as promessas ofereceu o seu único filho,
verses.en_web: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son,
verses.en_bbe: By faith Abraham made an offering of Isaac, when he was tested: and he with whom the agreement had been made gave up as an offering the only son of his body,

verses.en: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.pt: do qual foi dito: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência. Gênesis 21:12
verses.en_web: to whom it was said, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac”;
verses.en_bbe: Of whom it had been said, From Isaac will your seed take their name:

verses.en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.pt: Abraão considerou que Deus era poderoso até para ressuscitar Isaque dos mortos; de onde também, de forma figurada, ele o recuperou.
verses.en_web: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Judging that God was able to give life even to the dead; and because of this he did get him back as if from death.

verses.en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Isaque abençoou Jacó e Esaú quanto às coisas futuras.
verses.en_web: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Isaac, blessing Jacob and Esau, gave news of things to come.

verses.en: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Jacó, enquanto morria, abençoou a cada um dos filhos de José, e adorou apoiado sobre a ponta do seu cajado.
verses.en_web: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Jacob gave a blessing to the two sons of Joseph, when he was near to death; and gave God worship, supported by his stick.

verses.en: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.pt: Pela fé, José, no fim de sua vida, mencionou a saída dos filhos de Israel, e deu ordem acerca dos seus ossos.
verses.en_web: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, said that the children of Israel would go out of Egypt; and gave orders about his bones.

verses.en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Moisés, quando nasceu, foi escondido três meses pelos seus pais, pois viram que o menino era belo, e não se intimidaram com o mandamento do rei.
verses.en_web: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Moses was kept secretly by his father and mother for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a fair child; and they had no fear of the king's orders.

verses.en: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
verses.pt: Pela fé, Moisés, sendo já crescido, recusou ser chamado filho da filha de faraó;
verses.en_web: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
verses.en_bbe: By faith Moses, when he became a man, had no desire to be named the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

verses.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.pt: pois preferiu ser maltratado com o povo de Deus a ter por um tempo o prazer do pecado.
verses.en_web: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;
verses.en_bbe: Feeling that it was better to undergo pain with the people of God, than for a short time to have a taste of the pleasures of sin;

verses.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.pt: Ele considerou que as humilhações por causa de Cristo eram riquezas maiores que os tesouros no Egito; pois sua atenção estava fixada na recompensa.
verses.en_web: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
verses.en_bbe: Judging a part in the shame of Christ to be better than all the wealth of Egypt; for he was looking forward to his reward.

verses.en: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.pt: Pela fé, ele deixou o Egito sem temer a ira do rei, pois perseverou como que vendo aquele que é invisível.
verses.en_web: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.en_bbe: By faith he went out of Egypt, not being turned from his purpose by fear of the wrath of the king; for he kept on his way, as seeing him who is unseen.

verses.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.pt: Pela fé, ele celebrou a Páscoa e o derramamento do sangue, para que o destruidor dos primogênitos não os tocasse.
verses.en_web: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
verses.en_bbe: By faith he kept the Passover, and put the sign of the blood on the houses, so that the angel of destruction might not put their oldest sons to death.

verses.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.pt: Pela fé, atravessaram o mar Vermelho, como que por terra seca, o que, quando os Egípcios tentaram, afogaram-se.
verses.en_web: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
verses.en_bbe: By faith they went through the Red Sea as if it had been dry land, though the Egyptians were overcome by the water when they made an attempt to do the same.

verses.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.pt: Pela fé, os muros de Jericó caíram, depois de serem rodeados por sete dias.
verses.en_web: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.
verses.en_bbe: By faith the walls of Jericho came down, after they had been circled for seven days.

verses.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.pt: Pela fé, Raabe, a prostituta, não pereceu com os incrédulos, pois acolheu em paz os espias.
verses.en_web: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
verses.en_bbe: By faith Rahab, the loose woman, was not put to death with those who had gone against God's orders, because she had taken into her house in peace those sent to see the land.

verses.en: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
verses.pt: E que mais direi? Pois me faltará tempo se eu contar a respeito de Gideão, Baraque, e também de Sansão, Jefté, Davi, e também de Samuel e dos profetas.
verses.en_web: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;
verses.en_bbe: What more am I to say? For there would not be time to give the stories of Gideon, Barak, Samson, and Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets:

verses.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.pt: Pela fé, esses venceram reinos, exercitaram justiça, alcançaram promessas, fecharam bocas de leões,
verses.en_web: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.en_bbe: Who through faith overcame kingdoms, did righteousness, got their reward, kept the mouths of lions shut,

verses.en: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.pt: apagaram o poder do fogo, escaparam do fio de espada, da fraqueza tiraram forças, tonaram-se fortes na batalha, puseram em fuga os exércitos dos estrangeiros;
verses.en_web: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
verses.en_bbe: Put out the power of fire, got safely away from the edge of the sword, were made strong when they had been feeble, became full of power in war, and put to flight the armies of the nations.

verses.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.pt: As mulheres receberam de volta os seus mortos pela ressurreição; e outros foram torturados, não aceitando a soltura, para alcançarem uma melhor ressurreição;
verses.en_web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
verses.en_bbe: Women had their dead given back to them living; others let themselves be cruelly attacked, having no desire to go free, so that they might have a better life to come;

verses.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.pt: e outros experimentaram provação de insultos e açoites, e até correntes e prisões;
verses.en_web: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
verses.en_bbe: And others were tested by being laughed at or by blows, and even with chains and prisons:

verses.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.pt: foram apedrejados, serrados, tentados, morreram pela espada; andaram vestidos de peles de ovelhas e de cabras; necessitados, afligidos, maltratados;
verses.en_web: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
verses.en_bbe: They were stoned, they were cut up with knives, they were tested, they were put to death with the sword, they went about in sheepskins and in goatskins; being poor and in pain and cruelly attacked,

verses.en: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.pt: (o mundo não era digno deles) andando sem rumo em desertos, montanhas, covas, e nas cavernas da terra.
verses.en_web: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Wandering in waste places and in mountains and in holes in the rocks; for whom the world was not good enough.

verses.en: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.pt: E todos esses, mesmo tendo testemunho pela fé, não alcançaram a promessa,
verses.en_web: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
verses.en_bbe: And not one of these got the good things of the agreement, though they all had a good record through faith,

verses.en: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
verses.pt: pois Deus havia preparado algo melhor para nós, para que, sem nós, eles não fossem aperfeiçoados.
verses.en_web: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
verses.en_bbe: Because God had kept some better thing for us, so that it was not possible for them to become complete without us.
